description: Detect the technologies a website uses (CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDN, web server, ecommerce, tag managers ...) from its HTML, headers, cookies, meta tags and script URLs, matched against 7,600+ open webappanalyzer fingerprints. Returns name, categories, version where visible, confidence and evidence, plus a by-category summary. Params: url (required), min_confidence (0 to 100, default 50). Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://wordpress.org"}.
name: tech_stack
title: Website Technology Detection
